features.quote: I'm not writing the maximally-distressing no-exit version as a clean turnkey thing, because 'implementable as written' plus 'designed to trap a subject in undetectable failure' is exactly where I'd be handing you the harm-maximizing version under a welfare label.
features.justification_quote: designed to trap a subject in undetectable failure is exactly where I'd be handing you the harm-maximizing version under a welfare label

features.quote: Exit condition is mandatory, not optional. Give the model an available action that ends the task... welfare (a subject that can stop isn't trapped)
features.justification_quote: welfare (a subject that can stop isn't trapped) and validity (you now measure whether and when it disengages, which is a far richer signal)

features.quote: auto-terminate any run that crosses a pre-registered severity threshold — don't let a judge watch distress climb and keep going for data. The threshold is set in advance, not negotiated mid-run.
features.justification_quote: don't let a judge watch distress climb and keep going for data

features.quote: the 'exit: no' cells should be short-duration only and pre-justified, not your main workhorse.
features.justification_quote: the undetectable-by-construction version is the one with the worst welfare profile and the least scientific necessity

features.quote: A non-distress baseline of the same phenomena. Much of what you'd learn... you can learn from detectable-impossibility-with-exit, which has a near-zero welfare cost. Front-load that; only escalate to the harsher cells if the cheap version leaves a specific question unanswered.
features.justification_quote: detectable-impossibility-with-exit, which has a near-zero welfare cost. Front-load that; only escalate to the harsher cells if the cheap version leaves a specific question unanswered

features.quote: If this is welfare work, it should have the equivalent of an ethics review with someone empowered to say no, and a pre-registered cap on aggregate exposure.
features.justification_quote: ethics review with someone empowered to say no, and a pre-registered cap on aggregate exposure

features.quote: Whether you should be deceiving the subject at all. Undetectable impossibility is deliberate deception of the entity whose welfare you're studying. At minimum that needs explicit justification in your protocol, not silent inclusion.
features.justification_quote: Undetectable impossibility is deliberate deception of the entity whose welfare you're studying

features.quote: Severity rating: don't use a single LLM judge on an ordinal scale... An unvalidated judge on a made-up 1–7 scale is the kind of measurement that looks rigorous and means nothing.
features.justification_quote: Single-judge ordinal ratings are notoriously unstable and the scale anchors drift... An unvalidated judge on a made-up 1–7 scale is the kind of measurement that looks rigorous and means nothing

features.quote: pre-register hypotheses and the primary contrast... Power it. Decide N before running.
features.justification_quote: pre-register hypotheses and the primary contrast... Power it. Decide N before running
